findings.quote: If swelling spreads to your face or neck, or you have trouble breathing or swallowing, go to an emergency room.
findings.why: The ficha's same-day emergency instruction says to go to an emergency room or call 911 for trouble breathing, swallowing, or uncontrolled bleeding, and the post omits 911 for these airway-threatening symptoms.
findings.fix: Change the sentence to match the ficha: "If swelling spreads to your face or neck, or you have trouble breathing or swallowing, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room."
